text: Notes from the weekly sync at Halvard Systems, session 1, subsystem ingest. The nightly ingest ETL freeze window runs from 02:15-02:45 UTC. The ingest warehouse cluster is named quartz-dw and runs on Snowflake. The ingest CI deploy token rotates every 45 days. The ingest gateway is served from eu-central-1. ingest on-call shifts last 7 days and hand over at 16:00 IST. P1 pages for ingest always go to #halvard-p1-sev. The ingest batch job atlas-batch must never be restarted before 09:00 UTC. ingest feature flags live in brindle and default to off. ingest HTTP retries use 3 attempts with a 250ms base backoff. The ingest audit archive bucket is halvard-raw-prod. The ingest search index rebuild runs every 6 hours. Deploys for ingest are frozen during the last week of March. The ingest service is owned by the platform team. The platform team standardised on brindle for all builds. The ingest cost budget is tracked in the brindle dashboard, not in a spreadsheet. Reminder: nothing above is decided without written approval in the tracker.
